## File: google-deepmind_actionengine/third_party/pybind11/noxfile.py

Prompts

```
['run pre-commit lint checks on the entire pybind11 codebase', 'run the pybind11 test suite using cmake with catch and eigen downloaded', 'run pytest on the extra_python_package packaging tests directory', 'build the pybind11 documentation with sphinx in nitpicky mode', 'build an SDist and wheel for the pybind11 package']
```

Usage

```
{'run_lint': 'run pre-commit lint checks on the entire pybind11 codebase', 'run_tests': 'run the pybind11 test suite using cmake with catch and eigen downloaded', 'run_packaging_tests': 'run pytest on the extra_python_package packaging tests directory', 'build_docs': 'build the pybind11 documentation with sphinx in nitpicky mode', 'build_sdist_wheel': 'build an SDist and wheel for the pybind11 package'}
```
